strings.Checks run one after another; the slowes: Checks run one after another; the slowest was {name} ({t}).
strings.Helps zing pick the right model profile: Helps zing pick the right model profile when the model name alone is ambiguous. Choosing a model from the list fills it in.
strings.Each check shows its score and how long: Each check shows its score and how long it took; checks with findings expand to show the evidence.
